evidence_type: Assistant visual transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver aggregate screenshot. All three rows, five column headers and fifteen result fields are fully visible; no direct learner-database inspection.
learner_action_type: Read-only full-observation visitor-item pair funnel with strictly ordered view, qualifying cart and qualifying transaction.
display_normalization: Remove integer thousands separators. Retain displayed percentage strings in observed_rows. Normalize non-null percentages with Decimal to four places in results: VIEW share 100 becomes 100.0000 and final share 0.783 becomes 0.7830. Preserve the first-row displayed [NULL] step rate as JSON null. No value changes or label reconstruction.
visibility_accounting: Three integer pair counts + five non-null percentage cells + one NULL step-rate cell + three complete stage labels + three PASS statuses = fifteen report fields. DBeaver UI row numbers are excluded.
fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of three compact JSON row arrays in output_columns order followed by LF. Pair counts remain integers, non-null percentages use exact four-place Decimal strings, and the base step rate remains JSON null.
scope: Accepts all fifteen visible SQL71 aggregate fields and three PASS rows. The full-observation cohort has 2,132,127 distinct visitor/item pairs with a recorded view; 45,804 reach a strictly later qualifying cart, and 16,695 reach a transaction strictly after that cart. Shares of the view cohort are 100.0000%, 2.1483% and 0.7830%; the conditional cart-to-transaction step rate is 36.4488%. Each pair contributes at most once per nested stage; source duplicates remain preserved. Same-millisecond events do not establish order. Paths without a recorded view are excluded. Full-period progression has unequal follow-up and observation-boundary truncation; absent later events do not prove abandonment. These are anonymous pair paths rather than people, validated orders, sessions, fixed-window conversion or causal effects. Screenshot acceptance is separate from database inspection and the earlier five-field source preflight, does not reverify UTC/property fields, and does not test learner conceptual understanding. Historical pending statements remain unchanged; this appendix establishes current learner acceptance.
